Lock: uv.lock package opencv-python-headless 4.11.0.86
Wheel metadata requires numpy >= 1.26.0 on Python 3.12. numpy is already in the AGNOS venv and is not vendored here.

Unpacked next to this file so import cv2 works when starpilot/third_party is on PYTHONPATH.
cv2/cv2.abi3.so records RPATH $ORIGIN/../opencv_python_headless.libs.
Its non-bundled SONAMEs are libz.so.1, libpthread.so.0, libdl.so.2,
libstdc++.so.6, libm.so.6, libgcc_s.so.1, libc.so.6, and ld-linux-aarch64.so.1.
The OpenCV, ffmpeg, openblas, png, and gfortran libraries are the copies in
opencv_python_headless.libs. This host cannot execute the aarch64 module.
